description: This file defines the Cron model class for the OpenCart admin module, providing CRUD operations for cron job records in the database.
external_files: config.php or similar for DB_PREFIX, but not explicitly shown

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Model class for managing cron jobs in the database, including adding, deleting, editing, and fetching cron records.

methods.name: addCron
methods.description: Creates a new cron record in the database with specified data.

methods.name: deleteCron
methods.description: Deletes a cron record identified by cron_id.

methods.name: deleteCronByCode
methods.description: Deletes a cron record identified by code.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the date_modified of a cron record identified by cron_id.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a cron record.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Fetches a cron record by cron_id.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Fetches a cron record by code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cron records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total count of cron records in the database.
